title: NucleoNet: A Nuclear-Aware Determinant Ansatz for Multi-Geometry Neural Variational Monte Carlo
abstract: arXiv:2610.12985v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural-network variational Monte Carlo provides an accurate route to solving the electronic Schr\"odinger equation, but many neural wavefunctions are optimized for a single nuclear geometry, requiring separate calculations to map out a potential energy surface. We introduce NucleoNet, a nuclear-aware determinant ansatz in which electrons and nuclei form a unified particle set propagated through a shared electron--nucleus backbone that jointly evolves one-particle and two-particle representations. Nuclei carry learned representations that evolve alongside the electronic representations and condition orbital construction, while antisymmetry is imposed only by electronic determinants. On equilibrium small-molecule benchmarks, NucleoNet achieves accuracy comparable to established neural-wavefunction baselines with substantially fewer parameters. translated_title: NucleoNet：面向多几何构型神经变分蒙特卡洛的核感知行列式拟设
translated_abstract: 神经网络变分蒙特卡洛为求解电子薛定谔方程提供了一条精确的途径，但许多神经波函数仅针对单个核几何构型进行优化，需要分别进行多次计算才能绘制出势能面。我们提出了 NucleoNet，这是一种核感知的行列式拟设，其中电子与原子核构成一个统一的粒子集合，通过共享的电子-原子核骨干网络进行传播，该骨干网络联合演化单体与双体表示。原子核携带可学习的表示，与电子表示一同演化并对轨道构建进行条件化，而反对称性仅由电子行列式施加。在平衡构型的小分子基准测试中，NucleoNet 以显著更少的参数量达到了与现有神经波函数基线相当的精度。对于每个分子体系，一个跨多个几何构型联合优化的单一模型即可描述该分子的势能面。
tldr: NucleoNet 提出一种核感知的神经行列式拟设，将电子与原子核纳入统一的共享骨干网络中联合演化，使单一模型可跨多个核几何构型联合优化，从而以更少的参数准确描绘分子势能面。
en_tdlr: NucleoNet is a nuclear-aware determinant ansatz that unifies electrons and nuclei in a shared electron–nucleus backbone, enabling a single model jointly optimized across multiple geometries to accurately describe molecular potential energy surfaces with substantially fewer parameters.
